name: Maltiverse IoC lookups (api.maltiverse.com)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and paid business plans (A8 trusted); P154 final condition 2: 'Registry provider maltiverse: tier trusted, terms key-terms'.

reliability.justification: Aggregator: classification and blacklist[] re-serve third-party feeds (abuse.ch, Spamhaus, Blocklist.de, sandboxes...) plus its own research; sandbox connectivity checks list benign hosts as malicious (http://example.com), so a listing needs corroboration (P154 cond 4).

maltiverse.description: Maltiverse API key (Authorization: Bearer; read-only lookups /ip, /hostname, /url, /sample)
maltiverse.plan_hint: Use a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use and record it as key_plans.maltiverse='business' (P154 cond 2); never an analyst's personal free account (rule 1).

lookup.title: Maltiverse API lookups GET /ip/{ip}, /hostname/{domain}, /url/{sha256(url)}, /sample/{sha256} (keyed only; never PUT/DELETE, /ioc, /bulk, /search or login)

terms.quote: P154 cond 1-2 (binding council text): keyed only in this build; keyless community use stays unbuilt until legal records its terms (the terms page is JS-only, unverified 2026-11-26). The key comes from a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (key_plans.maltiverse='business'). Registry provider maltiverse: tier trusted, terms key-terms.

lookup.notes: Research C0341 (verified live 2026-11-26: keyless 200, RateLimit-Limit 20 per 86400 s, no RateLimit-Remaining). Unknown objects answer HTTP 200 with a neutral stub {classification, type, urlchecksum} = not in Maltiverse (EMPTY, never a neutral vote). Errors: {"status":"fail","message":...} inside 200 (python-maltiverse README) -> module error markers (quota/rate/error). Aggregator (P154 cond 4): blacklist[].source and dates are kept per hit; the module states the families of its recent listings in finding data['upstream_families'] so CR27 counts Maltiverse only for listings whose source V3LUM does not query directly (embeds). Context booleans (sinkhole/tor/vpn/proxy/scanner/cdn/hosting) are tags, never malicious (cond 5).
lookup.licensed_alternative: A Maltiverse company plan recorded by legal as key_plans.maltiverse='business'; meanwhile the direct feeds it re-serves (abuse.ch, Spamhaus, Blocklist.de...) and the manual Maltiverse search page.

x_quota_note: The day block is the observed keyless limit (RateLimit-Limit: 20 per 86400 s, 2026-11-26; published: false), kept as the fail-safe budget until legal records the company plan's limit (P154 cond 3, P334): replace it with the recorded plan. A 429 whose RateLimit-Reset is beyond one hour, or a fail message naming a quota, is QUOTA (module markers).
notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-1 (P154, module threat_intel_ioc/maltiverse). Keyed only (NEEDS_KEY without key 'maltiverse'); keyless lookups are never sent. Cache 24 h (cond 3). The web host maltiverse.com is listed for the manual pivot links of pack threat_intel_g07_p3 only (never fetched by V3LUM).
